stem: A gym charges \$45 per month for a membership. A member who pays for 12 months in advance receives a \(12\%\) discount on the total cost of the 12 months. How much, in dollars, does a member pay for 12 months in advance?
solution: Cost of 12 months without the discount: \(45 \cdot 12 = 540\) dollars.
verify:
ans = 45 * 12 * (1 - Rational(12, 100))
assert ans == Rational('475.2')
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
